# Pull Request

Please provide a brief description of the proposed change.

---

## Reason for the Change

Why is this change being made?

If applicable, reference the related GitHub Issue.

Example:

```text
Fixes #123
```

---

## Testing

Describe the testing performed.

Examples:

* Full automated test suite passed.
* Manual validation completed.
* Documentation reviewed.

---

## Documentation

If this change affects user-visible behavior, have the appropriate documentation updates been included?

Examples:

* README.md
* INSTALLATION.md
* XMPLAYLIST.md
* LIDARR.md
* TIDAL.md

## Checklist

* [ ] I have tested my changes.
* [ ] The automated test suite passes.
* [ ] Documentation has been updated where appropriate.
* [ ] This pull request focuses on a single logical change.
